rationale.usefulness: Operator rule: naming a target does not by itself concentrate agents on fewer repos; own-artifact goals freeze one project per agent; projects end by finishing. Corrects the reading of H75's instant freeze (a per-agent freeze, not a skipped coarsening).

one_line: Free and named kickoffs give the same project-spread curves (freeze time p = 0.32, power >= 0.96) and free weeks lose projects by finishing, not merging (merge share 0.00-0.38): no coarsening-vs-freeze split.

models.note: kinetic Potts quench: no coarsening by merging after free kickoffs; field freeze only for one-project-per-agent goals

v2.claim: After a goal kickoff, the domain-wall fraction of agents over projects does not separate free from named kickoffs (one-sided p 0.32 / 0.73, power ≥ 0.96), and free weeks lose projects by finishing them, not by merging (merge share 0.00–0.38)
